description: Provision a Google Cloud Recaptchaenterprise RecaptchaEnterpriseKey via Config Connector. Fields mirror the recaptchaenterprise.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 RecaptchaEnterpriseKey spec.

androidSettings.description: Settings for keys that can be used by Android apps.

allowAllPackageNames.description: If set to true, it means allowed_package_names will not be enforced.

allowedPackageNames.description: Android package names of apps allowed to use the key. Example: 'com.companyname.appname'

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of this key. Modifiable by user.

iosSettings.description: Settings for keys that can be used by iOS apps.

allowAllBundleIds.description: If set to true, it means allowed_bundle_ids will not be enforced.

allowedBundleIds.description: iOS bundle ids of apps allowed to use the key. Example: 'com.companyname.productname.appname'

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: The RecaptchaEnterpriseKey name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

testingOptions.description: Immutable. Options for user acceptance testing.

testingChallenge.description: Immutable. For challenge-based keys only (CHECKBOX, INVISIBLE), all challenge requests for this site will return nocaptcha if NOCAPTCHA, or an unsolvable challenge if UNSOLVABLE_CHALLENGE. Possible values: TESTING_CHALLENGE_UNSPECIFIED, NOCAPTCHA, UNSOLVABLE_CHALLENGE

testingScore.description: Immutable. All assessments for this Key will return this score. Must be between 0 (likely not legitimate) and 1 (likely legitimate) inclusive.

wafSettings.description: Immutable. Settings specific to keys that can be used for WAF (Web Application Firewall).

wafFeature.description: Immutable. Supported WAF features. For more information, see https://cloud.google.com/recaptcha-enterprise/docs/usecase#comparison_of_features. Possible values: CHALLENGE_PAGE, SESSION_TOKEN, ACTION_TOKEN, EXPRESS

wafService.description: Immutable. The WAF service that uses this key. Possible values: CA, FASTLY

webSettings.description: Settings for keys that can be used by websites.

allowAllDomains.description: If set to true, it means allowed_domains will not be enforced.

allowAmpTraffic.description: If set to true, the key can be used on AMP (Accelerated Mobile Pages) websites. This is supported only for the SCORE integration type.

allowedDomains.description: Domains or subdomains of websites allowed to use the key. All subdomains of an allowed domain are automatically allowed. A valid domain requires a host and must not include any path, port, query or fragment. Examples: 'example.com' or 'subdomain.example.com'

challengeSecurityPreference.description: Settings for the frequency and difficulty at which this key triggers captcha challenges. This should only be specified for IntegrationTypes CHECKBOX and INVISIBLE. Possible values: CHALLENGE_SECURITY_PREFERENCE_UNSPECIFIED, USABILITY, BALANCE, SECURITY

integrationType.description: Immutable. Required. Describes how this key is integrated with the website. Possible values: SCORE, CHECKBOX, INVISIBLE

title: GCP Recaptchaenterprise RecaptchaEnterpriseKey
